'''Geoff Waring Death Star Superlaser''' is a [[Dark]] Death Star list Geoff Waring posted, preserved in [[Mick Larkins]]'s reply.<ref name="list-18787">[http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/18787 swccg-discussion message #18787], [[Mick Larkins]] quoting [[Geoff Waring]] (31 July 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010508201555/http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/18787 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Geoff Waring]]
* '''Published:''' 29 July 1997 (quoted 31 July 1997)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool)
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star|ANH-D-deathstar.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star Superlaser
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Superlaser Waring DS 1997.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Waring asked the list how they liked a Death Star Superlaser build.

== Strategy ==

Start at the Death Star, destroy planets, deploy Turbolaser Battery and Superlaser, and hold the Conference Room with Laser Gate.
